oneOf.description:
The agent process was asked to exit while the pane keeps its native
session reference; `agent.activate` relaunches it in place.

TabColor.description:
A named color tag on a tab. Clients map each name to a theme color.
`Unknown` is the fallback for a name this build does not know, so a newer
peer's color decodes (and is ignored) instead of failing the message.

color.description: The tab's color tag; absent when the tab has none.

important.description:
Marked important (`tab.set_reminder`, `tab.set_remind`): clients remind
while its agent sits finished (unseen) or blocked. Absent when not.

remind_every.description: The tab's scheduled reminder (`tab.set_reminder`); absent when off.

TabRemindInterval.description:
How often clients remind about a tab regardless of its agent: every 5, 10
or 30 minutes, every 1 or 6 hours, or daily at `ui.daily_reminder_time`.
`Unknown` is the fallback for an interval this build does not know; it is
never stored.

AgentActivateParams.description:
Relaunch a suspended agent in its own pane from the stored session
reference; `target` is the pane id or the name saved when it was suspended.

AgentMessageClaimParams.description:
`agent.message_claim`: the target took a queued message some other way
(agents_wait_for_message returned it), so it is not typed in.

pane.description: The claiming pane: only the message's target may claim it.

envelope.description: The text typed into the target (the sender's envelope around the body).

id.description: The message id (`m...`); the key of every log line about it.

target.description: The target agent (pane id or agent name, as `agent.prompt`).

text.description: The message body as the log shows it.

to_name.description: The target's name as the sender knows it (the log's `to_name`).

unix.description: When the sender sent it (unix seconds); `0` = now.

AgentNoticeDismissParams.description: `agent.notice_dismiss`: the cards to remove (`all` removes every card).

AgentNoticeKind.description:
The card's accent: `info` (default), `question` (blocked on the user),
`done` (a long task finished), `warning` (needs the user's care).

oneOf.description: A kind this side does not know (a newer peer); shown as `info`.

AgentNotifyParams.description: `agent.notify`: show the user a card from the agent in `caller_pane`.

body.description: At most 3 lines and 280 characters after sanitizing.

caller_pane.description: The calling pane (`HERDR_PANE_ID`); aliases of a moved pane resolve.

title.description: One line, at most 80 characters after sanitizing; must not be empty.

guard_user_typing.description:
Fork: refuse with `user_typing` (nothing typed) while the user typed
into the pane in the last few seconds or has an unsent draft in the
agent's input box. Set by automatic callers (agent messages); a
user's own `agent prompt` leaves it off.

AgentRestartParams.description:
Exit an idle live agent gracefully and relaunch it in the same pane with
its native resume command; `target` is a live agent name or the hosting
pane id.

timeout_ms.description: Startup timeout in milliseconds. Values must be greater than 3000 and at most 300000.

oneOf.description:
The agent process was asked to exit while the pane keeps its native
session reference; `agent.activate` relaunches it in place.

AgentSuspendParams.description:
Ask a live agent to exit gracefully while its pane keeps the native
session reference; `target` is a live agent name or the hosting pane id.

actor.description: Only entries by this actor (pane id or name).

target.description: Only entries about this pane or tab.

AgentsActorParams.description:
`agents.actor`: who the caller is, its team, its turn and its rights, with
the `team.context` change it has not been told yet (one call per MCP tool
call).

ack.description: Mark the team change as told (as `team.context`'s `ack`).

full.description: The whole roster, not just the changes since the last ack.

reads_messages.description:
The calling herdr_agents server reads messages by id
(`agents.read_messages`): messages for the caller's pane are typed in
as a one-line pointer while that server process runs, not pasted.

AgentsCheckAction.description:
The action `agents.check` decides, for CLI verbs without a dedicated
method.

oneOf.description: Tab color, important, reminders.
Suspend or restart an agent.
Activate a suspended agent.
Type into a shell pane.
Close a pane that is not its tab's last.
Make a team, set its purpose, rename or move a group.
An action this side does not know (a newer peer); always denied.

AgentsCheckParams.description: `agents.check`: decide an action for the CLI route and log it.

AgentsCheckpointParams.description: `agents.checkpoint`: add a checkpoint to another pane's timeline.

AgentsCloseTabParams.description:
`agents.close_tab`: exit the tab's agents gracefully, then close it, with
every agent resumable from the closed sessions.

allow_unresumable.description: Close even when an agent cannot be reopened.

force.description: Close a shell running a job, or an agent without a graceful exit.

AgentsDirectoryParams.description:
`agents.directory`: every group and tab, scoped. Without a filter and
with a caller: the caller's group in full plus every group's counts.

include_closed.description: Also the recently closed tabs (reads the closed-sessions store).

limit.description: The most tab rows (the rest is counted in `truncated`).

team.description: A team's group id or label.

AgentsFixParams.description:
`agents.fix`: the checks to fix; empty = every fixable check. A fix with
`edits_files` runs only when `confirm` is true.

AgentsLifecycleParams.description:
`agents.suspend`, `agents.activate` and `agents.restart`: an agent's
lifecycle in a tab, checked like a soft edit (activating an entry the user
suspended needs the caller's user turn, D4) and recorded with who did it.
They answer the `agent.*` results (`agent_suspended`, `agent_activated`,
`agent_restarted`).

target.description: A tab id, a pane id or an agent name (its tab's agent).

AgentsMoveTabParams.description: `agents.move_tab`: into a group, a new group, or the top space.

AgentsNotesAppendParams.description: `agents.notes_append`: append to another pane's notes (a teammate's).

AgentsOpenTabParams.description:
`agents.open_tab`: open a tab (a shell without `agent`), set its meta,
join its team and type the kickoff, in one step.

agent.description: `claude` or `codex`; absent opens a shell tab.

group.description: An existing group id or label.

kickoff.description: The first instruction for the new agent.

label.description: The tab label (default: the agent name).

name.description: The agent name (outside a team; in a team the role names it).

new_group.description: A new group with this label.

oneOf.description: A format this side does not know (a newer peer): plain text.

AgentsReadMessagesParams.description:
`agents.read_messages`: the full text of messages herdr typed into the
caller as a pointer line, with their envelope (sender, relation and how
to answer). Only messages addressed to the caller; reading marks them
read.

AgentsReadParams.description:
`agents.read`: a pane's screen, as `pane.read` reads it; shell screens only
for the pane's team and the coordinator (U6).

target.description: A pane id, agent name, tab id or unique tab label.

oneOf.description: A source this side does not know (a newer peer): read `recent`.

AgentsReopenTabParams.description: `agents.reopen_tab`: a closed tab from the closed sessions.

AgentsReorderGroupParams.description:
`agents.reorder_group`: move a group in the sidebar (the user's whole
sidebar: the coordinator in its user's turn, or the user). Exactly one of
`position`, `before` and `after`. The first space (the ungrouped tabs)
stays first.

after.description: Put it directly after this group.

before.description: Put it directly before this group.

group.description: A group id, label or number.

AgentsReorderTabParams.description:
`agents.reorder_tab`: move a tab among its group's tabs (free in the
caller's team).

target.description: A tab id, pane id, agent name or tab label.

AgentsSendMessageParams.description: `agents.send_message`: type a message into an idle agent. Never waits.

reply_to.description: The id of the message this answers.

to.description: An agent pane id, agent name or unique tab label.

AgentsSetMetaParams.description:
`agents.set_meta` (client-shell): a pane's role and note. An absent field
stays; an empty one clears it. Absent `caller_pane` means the user.

AgentsSettingsSetParams.description:
`agents.settings.set`: one `[agents]` key. `value` is a bool for `wrap`,
`tools`, `instructions`, `notices` and `team_roster`; a string for `instructions_file`
(`""` or `"default"` = built-in, `"file"` = `<config dir>/agents.md`,
seeded with the built-in text when missing, anything else = that path).

BrowserBatchStep.description:

(`use`, `close`, `focus`, or a step meant for another tab).

oneOf.description: Open a new background tab and make it the caller's current tab.

focus.description: Also select the tab and raise the window.

oneOf.description: `back`, `forward` or `reload`.

interactive.description: Only actionable nodes and their headings (snapshot only).

front.description: Select the tab and raise the window first (logged as `focus`).

out.description: Write the full-size file here instead of `shots/`.

oneOf.description: `accept` (with optional prompt text) or `dismiss` an open dialog.
Make the tab in `BrowserRunParams.tab` the caller's current tab.
Close the current (or `BrowserRunParams.tab`) tab.
Select the tab and raise the window (for the human).
Click an element (`ref` from a snapshot, or a CSS `selector`).
Type into an element key by key (`clear` first, `submit` presses Enter after).
Press a key (`Enter`, `Control+a`, …) on an element or the focused one.
Pick an option of a `<select>` by value or label.
Set an input's value at once.

An aria snapshot with refs (`read --format snapshot`); as a batch step
its refs serve the following steps and its output is kept.
Several steps on one tab, in order, under one deadline.

Glide the activity cursor before each act step (default true; false
skips the glide, the frame and the tab group stay).

close_opened.description: Close the tabs this batch opened, after the final step (default false).

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true).

BrowserCaller.description:
Who is calling: the pane whose environment the CLI or the MCP server ran
in (`HERDR_PANE_ID`), or `--pane`.

BrowserFixParams.description: `browser.fix`: the checks to fix; empty = every failing fixable check.

since_seq.description: Answer `{unchanged: true}` when nothing changed since this sequence number.

BrowserRunParams.description:
One operation of `browser.run`. Unknown operations (an older server) map
to `Unknown`, which answers `unknown_op`.

oneOf.description: Open a new background tab and make it the caller's current tab.

focus.description: Also select the tab and raise the window.

interactive.description: Only actionable nodes and their headings (snapshot only).

front.description: Select the tab and raise the window first (logged as `focus`).

out.description: Write the full-size file here instead of `shots/`.

oneOf.description: `accept` (with optional prompt text) or `dismiss` an open dialog.
Make the tab in `BrowserRunParams.tab` the caller's current tab.
Close the current (or `BrowserRunParams.tab`) tab.
Select the tab and raise the window (for the human).
Click an element (`ref` from a snapshot, or a CSS `selector`).
Type into an element key by key (`clear` first, `submit` presses Enter after).
Press a key (`Enter`, `Control+a`, …) on an element or the focused one.
Pick an option of a `<select>` by value or label.
Set an input's value at once.

An aria snapshot with refs (`read --format snapshot`); as a batch step
its refs serve the following steps and its output is kept.
Several steps on one tab, in order, under one deadline.

animate.description:
Glide the activity cursor before each act step (default true; false
skips the glide, the frame and the tab group stay).

close_opened.description: Close the tabs this batch opened, after the final step (default false).

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true).

profile.description: The profile to use; switches the caller's cursor to it.

tab.description: `main:t3` or `t3`; unset = the caller's current tab.

BrowserSettingsSetParams.description:
`browser.settings.set`: one `[browser]` key. `value` is a bool for the
toggles, a `#rrggbb` string for `activity_color`, an array of agent names
for `mcp_agents`.

oneOf.description: A kind this client does not know (a newer server).

kinds.description: Only these kinds; empty means all.

since_seq.description: The `seq` the caller already has; a match replies `unchanged`.

CheckpointsUpdateParams.description: `checkpoints.update`: the given fields replace the stored ones.

ClientShellSurfaceSetParams.description: Updates whether the requesting client shell receives and controls pane presentation.

ClosedSessionTarget.description: A closed session by its record id.

command_id.description: Opaque endpoint-issued command identifier from the client-shell projection.

selection.description: Client-owned selection coordinates, validated against the pane's content revision.

CoordinatorOpenDashboardParams.description:
`coordinator.open_dashboard`: clears unread suggestions; with `open`
(default true) the server opens the dashboard URL.

caller_pane.description: The calling pane (`HERDR_PANE_ID`); absent means the user.

NewsHistoryParams.description: `news.history`: the editions index, optionally only the last `days` days.

NewsOpenParams.description: `news.open`: focus the News tab; with `edition`, show that edition.

NewsSetEnabledParams.description: `news.set_enabled`: turn scheduled runs on or off (written to the config).

NewsSetQuietHoursParams.description:
`news.set_quiet_hours`: the local window in which a news notification
waits, `HH:MM-HH:MM` (written to the config as `news.quiet_hours`), or
empty for none.

NewsSetTimesParams.description:
`news.set_times`: the local times of the scheduled runs (written to the
config as `news.times`, sorted and without duplicates). Every entry must
be `HH:MM`; an empty list means no scheduled runs.

NotesAppendParams.description:
`notes.append`: add text at the end, or at the end of `## <section>`
(created at the end when missing). Never conflicts.

stamp.description: Prefix the text with `- HH:MM ` (local time).

oneOf.description: An author this client does not know (a newer server).

known_revision.description:
The revision the caller already has; a match replies `unchanged`
without the text.

NotesSetParams.description:
`notes.set`: replace the text when `base_revision` is current (compare
and swap). `None` only succeeds while no notes file exists.

NotesTarget.description:
Which notes a request is about. Precedence: `key` > `pane_id` > `tab_id`;
all `None` is `invalid_params`.

key.description: A session key (`<agent>-<session id>` or `tab-<tab id>`).

PaneReportSubagentParams.description:
A Claude Code subagent starting or stopping in a pane's agent
(`pane.report_subagent`, sent by the Claude hook asset).

subagent_id.description: The subagent a `start` or `stop` is about; unused by `snapshot`.

subagent_ids.description:
`snapshot`: every subagent still running (from the main agent's Stop
hook); replaces the pane's set.

oneOf.description: Outer popup size in terminal cells, including the border.
Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

socket_path.description: Absolute remote-host agent socket. Registration lasts until this API connection closes.

oneOf.description: The authoritative running set, sent at every main turn end.

TabColor.description:
A named color tag on a tab. Clients map each name to a theme color.
`Unknown` is the fallback for a name this build does not know, so a newer
peer's color decodes (and is ignored) instead of failing the message.

TabRemindEvery.description:
A scheduled reminder as set through `tab.set_reminder`: off or an
interval. Closed: an unknown name rejects the request.

TabSetColorParams.description: Set or clear (`color: null`) a tab's color tag.

TabSetRemindParams.description:
Mark (`remind: true`) or unmark a tab as important: clients remind about
an important tab whose agent waits unseen. The boolean form of
`tab.set_reminder`'s `important`.

TabSetReminderParams.description:
Change a tab's reminders: `important` and/or the scheduled reminder
`every`. An absent field leaves that reminder as it is.

TeamContextParams.description:
`team.context`: the agent-side read (`HERDR_PANE_ID`). Read-only except
for `ack`, which marks the current revision as told to this member.

ack_key.description:
With `ack`: the `ack_key` of the read whose text was delivered. The
ack applies only while it still names the pane's current team (or
its pending "no longer in a team" line), so an ack that arrives after
a disband, a re-make or a move never marks another team as told.
Absent: whatever is current (a read and its ack in one call).

ack_revision.description:
With `ack`: mark only up to this revision as told (the revision the
caller read and delivered), so a change landing between a read and a
later ack is not lost. Absent: the current revision.

full.description: The whole roster block, not just the changes since the last ack.

TeamGetParams.description: `team.get`: the team of a group, or of the caller's group.

workspace_id.description: A group id (or label); absent means `caller_pane`'s group.

TeamJoinParams.description:
`team.join`: the pane joins its group's team (clearing a removal). With
a role it may join before its agent starts (a pre-launch join).

TeamMakeParams.description:
`team.make`: mark a group as a team. Every pane in it with a live agent
joins, with no role.

caller_pane.description: The calling agent's pane; absent means the user.

purpose.description: One line, at most 80 characters after sanitizing.

TeamPaneParams.description:
`team.leave`: the pane leaves its team and is not auto-joined again
until it joins or moves in.

TeamSetPurposeParams.description: `team.set_purpose`: a missing or empty purpose clears it.

TeamSetRoleParams.description: `team.set_role`: a missing or empty role clears it (the name stays).

role.description: One line, at most 32 characters after sanitizing.

source_workspace_id.description: Workspace whose focused pane supplies the `follow` cwd policy.

oneOf.description:
The agent process was asked to exit while the pane keeps its native
session reference; `agent.activate` relaunches it in place.

AgentActionEntry.description:
One line of `actions.jsonl`: an agent action, a denial, a completion, or
a user action on tabs and teams.

oneOf.description: A pane with no live agent (its user types there).
An actor this side does not know (a newer peer).

completion_seq.description: The current idle transition completed work, independently of who has viewed it.

subagents.description:
Claude Code subagents running under this agent (`pane.report_subagent`),
background ones included, whatever its status; absent when none or
while suspended.

oneOf.description: Typed into the target now; the sender logs it.
Queued by the server (which logged it); typed in once the target is free.

AgentNoticeInfo.description:
One card as `agent.notices`, `agent.notice_dismiss` and the
`endpoint.agent-notices.v1` push report it. Tab and workspace are resolved
when the list is built (the pane may have moved since the card was made).

agent.description: The sender's agent kind (`claude`, `codex`), when known.

name.description: The sender: agent name, else agent kind, else pane id.

unix.description:
When the card was made (or last refreshed by a duplicate), seconds
since the Unix epoch.

AgentNoticeKind.description:
The card's accent: `info` (default), `question` (blocked on the user),
`done` (a long task finished), `warning` (needs the user's care).

oneOf.description: A kind this side does not know (a newer peer); shown as `info`.
A new card (it replaced the sender's previous card, if any).

Same title and body as the sender's current card within 10 minutes:
the card was refreshed, no rate-limit slot was used.
An agent pane: live, suspended or launch-pending.
A kind this side does not know (a newer peer).

The agent process was asked to exit while the pane keeps its native
session reference; `agent.activate` relaunches it in place.

AgentTranscriptBackupPass.description:
A finished native transcript backup pass, as reported by
`agent.transcripts`.

finished_unix.description: When the pass finished, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

skipped.description: Sessions without a native transcript, or whose agent has none.

updated.description: Sessions whose transcript or side data was copied.

AgentVoiceMode.description:
Fork: an agent's voice mode, read from its screen (detection signal
`voice`). Absent while voice mode is off.

oneOf.description: A voice session with the microphone open.
A voice session with the microphone muted.
A mode this client does not know.

AgentsAccess.description: What a caller may do to a tab.

oneOf.description: The caller's own tab.
A tab in the caller's team (or any tab, for the coordinator).
Read and message only.
An access this side does not know (a newer peer).
An outcome this side does not know (a newer peer).

live.description: A live agent runs in the pane (not suspended, not launch-pending).

name.description: The agent name, else the agent kind.

pane_id.description: The caller's canonical public pane id.

rights.description: One line: what the caller may do.

team.description: The caller's team (absent outside a team, or when it left it).

team_update.description: The team change the caller has not been told yet.

edits_files.description:
The fix edits a user file: the client must confirm first and send
`agents.fix { confirm: true }`.

found.description:

Queued by the server (logged `queued`): typed in once the target is
free (src/app/message_queue.rs), or taken by the target's
agents_wait_for_message.
An outcome this side does not know (a newer peer).

reason.description:
Why a queued message was not typed in now (working, blocked, its
user typing, earlier messages waiting, ...).

team.description: The target's team (group id), when it is a member.

member.description: The new agent joined its group's team.

AgentsOriginDetail.description: A detail on a turn origin.

The user input came through a terminal-attach session.

cwd.description: Omitted for a shell outside the caller's team (U6).

member.description: A member of its group's team.

id.description: The group's workspace id or the tab's id.

of.description: How many groups or tabs there are.

AgentsScreenAccess.description: Whether a caller may read a pane's screen (U6).

renamed.description: A team member's name now follows the role.

setup_needed.description:
A check that only an explicit request may fix (an MCP registration,
the shell hook) is failing: the Browser row shows a `!` hint.

selected.description: The selected tab of its window.

users.description: Pane ids that touched it, most recent first.

BrowserTouch.description: The last agent touch of a tab.

CheckpointContextInfo.description:
The result of `checkpoints.context`: the prompt and reply around the
moment the checkpoint was made.

continued.description: The prompt is outside the read window (the turn started earlier).

CheckpointContextSource.description: Where a checkpoint's transcript context came from.

oneOf.description: The agent's live native transcript.
herdr's transcript backup.
herdr's previous transcript backup.
Still being read; ask again shortly.
No transcript was found.

The agent's transcripts are not readable by herdr, or the checkpoint
has no anchor (tab notes).
A source this client does not know (a newer server).

has_context.description:
The checkpoint has a transcript anchor (`checkpoints.context` can
answer with text).

oneOf.description: A kind this client does not know (a newer server).

folded.description:
The add matched a recent checkpoint (same kind, title and author) and
updated it instead.

seq.description: The store's change stamp after the write.

started_at.description: Unix seconds of the first checkpoint.

ClosedSessionInfo.description: One closed agent session, newest first in `session.closed_list`.

closed_at.description: When the tab was closed, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

id.description: Stable id of the record: the close time and the session id.

label.description: The tab's custom label, when it had one.

session_id.description: The agent's native session id (or path, for path references).

space_id.description: The space (workspace) the tab was in.

transcript_path.description: Where the agent kept the native transcript, when it was known.

CoordinatorBoardInfo.description: A summary of the coordinator's board; its content is for the dashboard.

CoordinatorGetInfo.description:
`coordinator.get`'s read model; every coordinator method answers with it
(as `ResponseResult::CoordinatorGet { info }`, `{"type": "coordinator_get",
"info": {...}}` on the wire).

dashboard_error.description: Why there is no dashboard URL (e.g. `port 7718 in use`).

dashboard_url.description: Only while the dashboard is listening.

migration_unmatched.description:
`managed.json` entries the agents-v2 migration could not place on a
pane (their roles and notes were not carried over); absent before the
migration ran.

notice.description: A one-time notice (e.g. after the migration from the POC).

wake_queued.description:
Set only on a `coordinator.wake` reply when the wake cannot be
delivered now: why it waits (e.g. `coordinator is working`). The wake
stays queued and is sent once the coordinator is idle.

wake_scope.description:
`[coordinator] wake_scope` (agents v2): which agents wake the
coordinator, and so which ones `managed` lists (`opened`, `teams`,
`all`). Absent from older servers.

CoordinatorManagedInfo.description:
One agent the coordinator watches (agents v2: in its wake scope; the
field keeps its v1 name `managed`). `project` is no longer filled (U3:
folded into the note).

CoordinatorStateInfo.description: The coordinator's lifecycle state as the read model reports it.

oneOf.description: A state this client does not know (a newer server).

CoordinatorTurnInfo.description: The live non-user turn marker, when one is set.

pending.description: Queued changes waiting for the next wake-up.

warnings.description:
Warnings collected at link time or on registry load (e.g. unknown event names,
missing manifest file). Non-fatal — the entry is kept and surfaced by plugin.list.

at.description: When it was published, ISO 8601 UTC.

NewsGetInfo.description:
`news.get`: what the client shell shows (the pinned row, the settings
section) and what `news.open` / `news.set_enabled` answer.

last_read_edition.description:
The last edition the reader looked at in the News tab (recorded when
the tab is focused with the viewer showing it); absent until then.

new_stories.description:
Stories in the latest edition that were not in `last_read_edition`
(by url); absent without a last-read edition or an index.

next_run_at.description:
The next scheduled run, seconds since the Unix epoch; absent while
scheduling is off or the server has no news home.

pending_notifications.description: Notifications waiting for a client shell or the end of quiet hours.

quiet_hours.description:
The configured quiet window, `HH:MM-HH:MM`, or empty; a notification
due inside it waits for its end.

tab_id.description: The News tab and its pane, while the tab exists.

times.description:
The scheduled local times, `HH:MM`, sorted (`news.times`); empty
means no scheduled runs.

unread.description:
The News tab is marked important: a run changed the page and the tab
has not been focused since.

error.description: The first recorded error of a run that did not succeed.

NewsNotifyInfo.description:
The editor's notification request (`decision.notify`) on a run that
changed the page. The server's policy decides whether it is delivered.

urgency.description: `low` or `high` (high may exceed the daily cap once).

phase.description:
`starting` (waiting for the pane's shell prompt), `running`, or
`stopping` (the watchdog signalled the runner; its record or the
pane's prompt ends the run).

NewsRunRecord.description:
One news run as recorded in `runs/index.jsonl`, newest first in
[`NewsStatusInfo::recent`].

changed.description: The editor's decision that the page changed (only meaningful on `ok`).

edition.description: The edition the run published, on `ok`.

ended.description: When the run ended, same form; absent for a record written without one.

notify.description: The editor's notification request (`decision.notify`), when it made one.

run.description: The runner's per-run directory name under `runs/` (local stamp).

started.description: When the run started, ISO 8601 UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00`).

summary.description: The editor's one-line summary of the run, when it gave one.

home.description: The news home directory (`<session data dir>/news`).

next_run_at.description:
The next scheduled run, seconds since the Unix epoch; absent while
scheduling is off or the server has no news home.

pending_notifications.description: Notifications waiting for a client shell or the end of quiet hours.

quiet_hours.description:
The configured quiet window, `HH:MM-HH:MM`, or empty; a notification
due inside it waits for its end.

tab_id.description: The News tab and its pane, once created.

times.description:
The scheduled local times, `HH:MM`, sorted (`news.times`); empty
means no scheduled runs.

oneOf.description: An author this client does not know (a newer server).

NotesInfo.description: A notes file as the server sees it.

previous.description: The key this pane used before its session changed (after `/clear`).

revision.description: `sha256:<12 hex>` of the text, or `none` while no file exists.

updated_at.description: Unix seconds of the last write through herdr.

NotesWriteInfo.description:
The result of `notes.set` and `notes.append`. `notes.revision` is the
revision after the write (the current one on a conflict).

oneOf.description:
`base_revision` was not the current revision; `notes` holds the
current text and nothing was written.
The text was already the current text.
An outcome this client does not know (a newer server).

PaneLinkRegion.description: Inclusive display-cell columns on a pane's current viewport.

oneOf.description: Outer popup size in terminal cells, including the border.
Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

enabled.description:
Whether backup passes run (the config flag and session
persistence together).

oneOf.description: `agent.notify` (fork).
`agent.notices` and `agent.notice_dismiss` (fork): every card, oldest first.

`agent.message_send` (fork): sent now or queued; `status` is the
target's status when it was decided, `reason` why it was queued.

`agent.message_claim` (fork): whether a queued message was taken off
the queue (false: not queued, or not addressed to the claimer).
`agents.settings` and `agents.settings.set` (fork).
`agents.fix` (fork): the checks after the fixes ran.
`team.list` (fork): every team, in sidebar order.

`team.get`, `team.make`, `team.disband`, `team.set_purpose`,
`team.set_role`, `team.join`, `team.leave` (fork). `renamed` is set by
`team.set_role` (and a `team.join` with a role): whether the member's
name now follows the role.
`team.context` (fork): the caller's team and the text to tell it.

ack_key.description:
What `text` comes from (the pane's team, or its pending "no
longer in a team" line), opaque; pass it back as `ack_key`.

eligible.description:
The caller's pane is in a team group, not removed from it, and
not the coordinator's (it joins once its agent is detected).

oneOf.description: `agents.actor`.
`agents.directory`.
`agents.read`.
`agents.open_tab`.
`agents.send_message`.
`agents.rename_tab`.
`agents.move_tab`.
`agents.set_meta`.
`agents.close_tab`.
`agents.reopen_tab`.
`agents.actions`: newest first.
`agents.check`: an allowed action (a denial is an error).
`agents.read_messages`, in the order asked.
`agents.reorder_group`, `agents.reorder_tab`.

file_frame_damage.description: Accepts damage metadata while still consuming a complete canonical file.

pane_visible.description: True only when this pane is on the currently rendered terminal surface.

oneOf.description:
Acknowledgement for the client-shell surface interest lease. This method is new on the
endpoint protocol, so its revision-bearing result can establish an activation floor.

endpoint_protocol_generation.description: Stable client-owned endpoint generation supported by this server.

health_check.description: Whether this server supports endpoint health probes.

ssh_agent_registration.description: Supports connection-scoped `server.ssh_agent.register` on the local JSON API.

surface_interest.description: Whether this server supports explicit client-shell surface interest.

TabColor.description:
A named color tag on a tab. Clients map each name to a theme color.
`Unknown` is the fallback for a name this build does not know, so a newer
peer's color decodes (and is ignored) instead of failing the message.

color.description: The tab's color tag; absent when the tab has none.

important.description:
Marked important (`tab.set_reminder`, `tab.set_remind`): clients remind
while its agent sits finished (unseen) or blocked. Absent when not.

remind_every.description: The tab's scheduled reminder (`tab.set_reminder`); absent when off.

TabRemindInterval.description:
How often clients remind about a tab regardless of its agent: every 5, 10
or 30 minutes, every 1 or 6 hours, or daily at `ui.daily_reminder_time`.
`Unknown` is the fallback for an interval this build does not know; it is
never stored.

TeamActor.description:
Who set a team's purpose: derived by the server from the calling pane's
own record (the coordinator's pane, else the agent's name), never from
parameters. Absent `caller_pane` means the user.

oneOf.description: An agent, named as it was at the time.
An actor this side does not know (a newer peer).

excluded.description: Panes removed from the team in place (public ids now).

revision.description: Bumped by every join, leave, role, purpose and member rename.

TeamMemberInfo.description: One member, with its pane and tab re-projected now.

agent.description: The agent kind (`claude`, `codex`); absent while no agent runs.

status.description:
Filled by `team.get`, `team.list` and `team.context`; never in the
`endpoint.teams.v1` push.
